Hero.name: Eduard Akhramovych
Hero.subtitle: Business speaker, entrepreneur, brand licensing expert and former CEO of Art Nation with 30+ years of experience in growth, retail and consumer engagement.
Hero.description: I help brands and leadership teams build scalable products, loyalty programs and market-entry strategies. My work connects business strategy, licensing, marketing and customer experience into practical growth systems.

paragraphs.first: For more than three decades, I have worked at the intersection of entrepreneurship, marketing, licensing and consumer products. My focus has always been the same: turn ambitious ideas into commercially disciplined businesses that people genuinely want.
paragraphs.second: From building nationwide retail distribution to scaling loyalty mechanics and collectible product ecosystems, I have led projects that combine creative positioning with measurable sales performance across multiple markets.
paragraphs.third: Today I work with founders, executive teams and event organizers who need strategic thinking, market insight and a speaker who can translate complex business growth topics into clear, usable frameworks.

national-multimedia-company.title: National multimedia company
national-multimedia-company.description: Built a distribution network of 4,573 retail points for licensed compact discs. By 2007, the annual turnover reached 20 million USD with a catalog of more than 30,000 products.

art-nation.title: Art Nation
art-nation.description: Sold more than 255 million collectible products. The company works with leading retailers in Ukraine and the CIS, while clients generate more than 200 billion UAH in annual turnover.

book-of-records-ukraine.title: Book of Records of Ukraine
book-of-records-ukraine.description: Set a national record in children's book sales with 1,241,000 copies sold in 2018.

book-of-records-moldova.title: Book of Records of Moldova
book-of-records-moldova.description: Expanded a proven publishing and licensing model to a neighboring market, adapting the product strategy for local demand and growth.

lecture.title: Keynote lecture
lecture.description: A strong fit for conferences, leadership teams and private sessions that need fresh thinking on brand growth, retail strategy, licensing, loyalty programs, gamification and customer engagement.

speech.title: Business speaking
speech.description: For business forums, corporate events and industry panels, Eduard delivers practical talks on entrepreneurship, marketing systems, sales, licensing and scalable product thinking.

consulting.title: Strategic consulting
consulting.description: Work directly on growth bottlenecks, monetization models, brand architecture, licensing strategy or market expansion with advice grounded in operating experience, not theory.
